lines.text: The apostle says he has seen Jesus our Lord, and the Corinthians are the seal of his apostleship.
The apostle asks if he and Silas are the only apostles who must work for a living.
The Law says not to muzzle a donkey treading grain, and the plowman expects to share in the harvest.
The apostle did not use his right to support and put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel.
The apostle says athletes train for a perishable crown, but he disciplines his body so he will not be disqualified.
